body.name: Fully specified shared-response replacement realization fiber
body.construction:
If
\[
 \operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)
 =\bigl(\widetilde S,\widetilde G_0,(\widetilde T_k)_{k=1}^{K}\bigr),
\]
define
\[
 \operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)
 :=\left\{\widetilde\eta\in\mathfrak M_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai}}:
 S_{\widetilde\eta}=\widetilde S,\quad
 G_0(\widetilde\eta)=\widetilde G_0,\quad
 T_k(\widetilde\eta)=\widetilde T_k\ \text{for every }k\in[K]
 \right\}.
\]
Membership therefore requires equality of the selection-set, basal-DAG, and direct-target components. The kernel family \(\kappa(\widetilde\eta)\), the shared exogenous law, and the response functions belong to each member \(\widetilde\eta\); none is inherited from \(\eta\). In particular, the fresh childless selection vertices introduced by \(\operatorname{RepGraph}\) must be realized inside the declared ambient tuple and model class.
